independence_declaration.shared_model_substrate_warning: One correlated model voice; role separation is not independent-model agreement.

source_basis.canonical_relation_source: Selected canonical passages were read from the same local WEB archive; editorial cross-references and edition markers were evidence only.

coverage_contract.confidence_policy: Every unit is LOW because this is a blind candidate primary, not an adjudicated or externally independent result.

macro_parents.title: Night visions and concluding crown sign-act
Fasting inquiry, remembered warning, and restored joy
First burden: cities, king and flock, and two shepherd enactments
Second burden: siege, mourning, cleansing, shepherd crisis, day-oracle, and holiness

units.title: Dated call to return and the fathers' response
units.literary_form: dated prophetic exhortation with retrospective response
units.deciding_marker: The word-arrival date at 1:1 introduces the exhortation; a fresh date and night-vision commission begin at 1:7.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not separate the date header from its commissioned message.
units.defensible_basis: Fathers, former prophets, overtaking word, and reported repentance form one return-warning sequence.

units.title: Horsemen among the myrtles and the comforting proclamations
units.literary_form: dated night vision with dialogue, intercession, interpretation, and proclamation
units.deciding_marker: The exact date opens at 1:7; a new lifted-eyes object vision begins at 1:18.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not split the horse report from the proclamation that resolves it.
units.defensible_basis: Question, patrol report, intercession, answer, and commissioned speech answer one another inside one vision.

units.title: Four horns answered by four craftsmen
units.literary_form: paired symbolic object vision and question-answer
units.deciding_marker: A lifted-eyes formula opens at 1:18; another lifted-eyes vision with measuring line opens at 2:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not separate scattering horns from answering craftsmen.
units.defensible_basis: The two miniature scenes form one antithetical vision; the chapter boundary is only corroborating metadata.

units.title: Measuring line, unwalled Jerusalem, escape call, and indwelling proclamation
units.literary_form: measuring vision expanded by summons and salvation proclamations
units.deciding_marker: The measuring-line report opens at 2:1; 3:1 changes to a priestly scene; 2:6 expands the Jerusalem response.
units.rejected_alternative: A 2:5/6 split is plausible but detaches escape, indwelling, nations, and silence from the city vision.
units.defensible_basis: Measurement, unwalled-city interpretation, Zion summons, dwelling, joining nations, and silence stay Jerusalem-centered.

units.title: Joshua's accusation, cleansing, commission, and sign-oracle
units.literary_form: priestly courtroom vision with symbolic reclothing and conditional sign-oracle
units.deciding_marker: Joshua is presented at 3:1; the scene closes at 3:10 before the seer is awakened at 4:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Splitting at 3:5, 3:6, or 3:8 detaches cleansing from commission and proof-texts Branch or stone.
units.defensible_basis: One setting binds accusation, rebuke, removal, reclothing, commission, and sign; canonical parallels decide no identity.

units.title: Lampstand, word to Zerubbabel, and two olive trees
units.literary_form: symbolic vision with nested questions and two-stage interpretation
units.deciding_marker: The angel awakens the seer at 4:1; 4:11 resumes trees reported at 4:3; a new vision begins at 5:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not treat the resumed olive-tree explanation as a new vision.
units.defensible_basis: The original object inventory contains lampstand and trees; Revelation 11 cannot identify figures or set a seam.

units.title: Flying scroll and the entering curse
units.literary_form: symbolic object vision with concise interpretation
units.deciding_marker: Lifted eyes and scroll open at 5:1; interpretation closes at 5:4; a new object begins at 5:5.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not merge scroll and ephah because they share a chapter and angel.
units.defensible_basis: Sight, dimensions, identification, and announced action complete one compact scroll vision.

units.title: Woman in the ephah carried to Shinar
units.literary_form: symbolic vision with unveiling, containment, transport, and destination
units.deciding_marker: A fresh seeing command begins at 5:5; destination closes at 5:11 before lifted eyes at 6:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach identification and containment from transport and destination.
units.defensible_basis: Question, unveiling, naming, sealing, lifting, and destination form one narrative movement.

units.title: Four chariots dispatched through the earth
units.literary_form: symbolic chariot vision with interpreting dialogue and dispatch
units.deciding_marker: Lifted eyes open at 6:1; dispatch closes at 6:8; a fresh word formula begins at 6:9.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not merge chariots with the crown sign-act or isolate the closing report.
units.defensible_basis: Report, question, interpretation, directions, motion, and result form one vision; Revelation 6 is later imagery only.

units.title: Crown sign-act, Branch oracle, and temple memorial
units.literary_form: word-commanded symbolic action with interpretation and memorial
units.deciding_marker: A word formula at 6:9 commands crowns; explanation and memorial continue through 6:15 before the date at 7:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not extract 6:12-13 or detach the closing obedience clause.
units.defensible_basis: Materials, crown, speech, memorial, and close depend on one action; Haggai/Ezra decide no identity or chronology.

units.title: Fasting inquiry answered by motive testing and the former prophets
units.literary_form: dated inquiry with two coordinated messenger-word responses
units.deciding_marker: The dated question generates replies at 7:4 and 7:8; 8:1 shifts to sustained restoration.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach the ethical demand and refusal history from the challenge to the fasts.
exact_alternatives: Zech.7.1-Zech.8.23 (macro retained, too broad as one unit)
units.defensible_basis: Question, motive challenge, ethics, refusal, and desolation form the negative answer; dates remain textual evidence only.

units.title: Restored Zion, strengthened hands, transformed fasts, and seeking nations
units.literary_form: cumulative restoration-saying chain answering the fasting inquiry
units.deciding_marker: Repeated messenger formulas accumulate through transformed fasts and seeking nations; a burden begins at 9:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not turn the chain into proof-text-sized promise, conduct, feast, and outreach fragments.
units.defensible_basis: Return, renewed streets, gathering, rebuilding, truth and peace, fasts, and nations progress cumulatively.

units.title: Burden against surrounding cities ending in protection of the house
units.literary_form: geographically progressing burden-oracle
units.deciding_marker: The burden opens at 9:1; the city itinerary closes at 9:8; direct rejoicing begins at 9:9.
units.rejected_alternative: Poetic blank lines inside 9:1-8 do not outweigh regional progression.
exact_alternatives: Zech.9.1-Zech.9.17 (addressee and royal movement change at 9:9)
units.defensible_basis: Named locations progress toward changed remnant status and protection; poetry metadata does not compel chunks.

units.title: Zion's king, covenant prisoners, defended flock, and abundance
units.literary_form: royal salvation proclamation expanding through release, conflict, defense, and abundance
units.deciding_marker: Rejoicing opens at 9:9; peace, release, defense, flock rescue, and abundance continue to 9:17; rain begins at 10:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Gospel reuse cannot authorize a 9:9-10 proof-text unit.
exact_alternatives: Zech.9.9-Zech.9.10 | Zech.9.11-Zech.9.17 (later citation not seam authority)
units.defensible_basis: King and peace widen to prisoners, mobilization, defense, flock rescue, and flourishing; later reuse decides no fulfillment.

units.title: Rain, false guides, shepherd reckoning, and the regathered flock
units.literary_form: flock-and-shepherd oracle moving from failed guidance to regathering
units.deciding_marker: Rain leads to failed guidance, shepherd reckoning, and regathering; a wailing summons begins at 11:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach regathering from shepherd diagnosis and flock visitation.
units.defensible_basis: Need, false guidance, visitation, strengthening, return, gathering, and renewed walking form one progression.

units.title: Wailing forest and the slaughter-flock shepherd with Favor and Union
units.literary_form: lament overture joined to a first-person shepherd sign-act
units.deciding_marker: The wail prepares the flock command at 11:4; the two-staff enactment closes at 11:14; 11:15 commands equipment again.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not orphan the lament or extract wages and potter because of Matthew 27.
units.defensible_basis: Destroyed shepherd glory leads to flock, staffs, rejection, wages, and broken staffs; later reuse decides no identity or authorship.

units.title: Foolish shepherd equipment and worthless-shepherd woe
units.literary_form: second shepherd sign-act command with closing woe
units.deciding_marker: The 'yet again' command begins at 11:15; the woe closes at 11:17 before the burden at 12:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not blur the explicit second command into the first sign-act.
units.defensible_basis: Equipment, conduct, and consequence make one short sign-oracle; no shepherd identity is selected.

units.title: Jerusalem besieged, Judah strengthened, and attackers opposed
units.literary_form: burden-oracle with repeated day formula and siege-defense imagery
units.deciding_marker: The burden opens at 12:1; siege-defense reaches 12:9; 12:10 turns to spirit and mourning.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not keep all 12:1-14 together when action and affect turn from battle to mourning.
units.defensible_basis: Gathering, destabilization, strengthened Judah, defense, and opposition form one movement; no historical siege is identified.

units.title: Spirit of supplication, pierced one, family mourning, and opened fountain
units.literary_form: communal lament completed by a cross-chapter cleansing image
units.deciding_marker: Spirit begins mourning at 12:10; family lament reaches the fountain at 13:1; 13:2 begins removal of idols and prophets.
units.rejected_alternative: The chapter boundary must not isolate mourning from the fountain, and later reuse must not isolate 12:10.
units.defensible_basis: Spirit produces looking, widening mourning, and an opened fountain; John 19 and Revelation 1 decide no identity or fulfillment.

units.title: Removal of idols and impure prophecy, with the ashamed-prophet scene
units.literary_form: purification oracle developing into a difficult prophetic social vignette
units.deciding_marker: The cut-off formula starts at 13:2; parents, prophets, garments, occupation, and wounds continue until the sword summons at 13:7.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate the wounds exchange from the deceptive-prophecy setting.
units.defensible_basis: Removal, parental rejection, prophetic shame, disguise refusal, and wounds form one sequence; no wounds interpretation is selected.

units.title: Sword against the shepherd, scattered sheep, and refined third
units.literary_form: poetic shepherd oracle moving from strike to refining and reciprocal speech
units.deciding_marker: The sword summons opens at 13:7; strike, scattering, refining, calling, and answer close at 13:9; a day-oracle begins at 14:1.
units.rejected_alternative: Gospel quotation cannot detach 13:7 from the flock and refining outcome.
units.defensible_basis: Shepherd strike, scattering, discipline, refining, and call-and-answer form one compact poem.

units.title: Day of battle, divine coming, altered light, living waters, kingship, and secure city
units.literary_form: extended day-oracle moving from siege through intervention to transformed city and creation
units.deciding_marker: 'Behold, a day' opens at 14:1; repeated day transitions connect battle through safety; a plague formula begins at 14:12.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not let chronology systems harden the 14:5/6 phase shift into an event chunk.
units.defensible_basis: Siege leads to intervention, escape, light, water, kingship, land, and safety; the 14:5 footnote selects no reading.

units.title: Plague, surviving nations at the feast, and holiness reaching ordinary vessels
units.literary_form: concluding judgment-to-pilgrimage oracle capped by pervasive holiness
units.deciding_marker: The plague opens at 14:12; surviving nations at 14:16 and holiness at 14:20 develop one reversal through 14:21.
units.rejected_alternative: Do not detach plague from survivors or pilgrimage from the holiness conclusion.
units.defensible_basis: Plague gives way to survivors, feast, rain consequences, and city-wide holiness; 14:21 selects no lexical reading.

hot_zones.risk: Isolate rebuke, Branch, stone, or one-day clauses and import identity systems.
hot_zones.control: Keep accusation, cleansing, commission, and sign-oracle together.

hot_zones.risk: Chapter fallback merges chariots and crown action or extracts 6:12-13.
hot_zones.control: Split at the 6:9 word formula and keep 6:9-15 intact.
Keep king, peace, prisoners, defense, flock, and abundance together.

hot_zones.risk: Wail, wages, potter, staffs, or woe are over-split and Matthew controls the map.
hot_zones.control: Keep 11:1-14; split only at the explicit second sign-act.

hot_zones.risk: Isolate 12:10 or 13:7 and obey chapter fallback at 13:1.
Micro-sequence an eschatological system or select footnote readings.
hot_zones.control: Use two large movements and decide no chronology, identity, fulfillment, or witness.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: Not direct-quotation, history, theology, or seam authority.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Garments, turban, iniquity, and priestly commission sit in Torah priestly-holiness vocabulary.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No ritual equivalence, lexical identity, or fulfillment.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Feast of booths and HOLY TO YAHWEH have explicit Torah contexts.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No chronology, typology, cultic history, or separate seam.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Shepherd material shares scattered-sheep-without-shepherd imagery.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No shepherd identity, occasion identity, or seam.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Megiddo mourning stands near the Josiah-at-Megiddo narrative.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No claim that the mournings are identical; no history decision.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Branch belongs to a royal plant/Branch imagery constellation.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: English resemblance proves no Hebrew lexical identity, person, or fulfillment.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Failed guides, regathering, and shepherd judgment resonate with prophetic shepherd movements.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No speaker identity, fulfillment, or imported seam.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Living waters toward the eastern region/sea and Arabah form a strong imagery context.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No map equivalence, chronology, or harmonized sequence.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Both texts use dated word formulas in Darius's second year and temple-centered exhortation.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: Internal textual coordination only; no history, chronology, authorship, or identity.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: The texts coordinate names, offices, prophetic activity, and temple building.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No extra-textual identity, historical synthesis, or chronology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Matthew and John explicitly reuse daughter-Zion, king, donkey, and colt wording.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: Later reuse cannot isolate 9:9-10 or decide fulfillment.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Matthew reuses thirty-pieces and potter wording in a composite citation context.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No authorship, preferred source account, fulfillment, identity, or seam decision.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: John explicitly quotes looking on the pierced one.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: Cannot split 12:10 from mourning/fountain or decide fulfillment.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Matthew and Mark explicitly quote the struck-shepherd/scattered-sheep line.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: Cannot split 13:7 or decide identity, fulfillment, or chronology.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Ephesians repeats speaking truth each one with his neighbor.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: Verbal reuse creates no Zechariah seam or theology decision.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Jude's Lord-rebuke-you formula resonates with Zechariah 3:2.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No participant identity or one-verse chunk.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Tested-by-fire gold resonates with the refined third.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: Motif only, not quotation, shared referent, fulfillment, or seam.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Revelation reuses two olive trees and two lampstands before the Lord of the earth.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No figure identity, doctrine, or 4:11 seam.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Differently colored horses strongly resonate with Zechariah's patrol and chariots.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No one-to-one identity, sequence, chronology, or fulfillment.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Revelation combines seeing the pierced one with tribal mourning.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No fulfillment, identity, chronology, or narrow chunk.

evidence_only_canonical_relations.observation: Illuminated city, nations, water, no curse, worship, and divine-name imagery form a dense later network.
evidence_only_canonical_relations.guard: No harmonized timeline, image identity, fulfillment, or Revelation-driven seam.

global_appeals.rationale: Double Come is a restart, though Jerusalem/Zion and dwelling continue.
Lament and shepherd command are distinct forms, though lament plausibly functions as overture.
Fountain resolves mourning but also introduces cleansing; highest-risk seam.
Battle/flight turns to altered light and waters, but split risks imposed chronology.
Plague, survivor pilgrimage, and holiness are distinct phases within one final reversal.

authority_guards: Candidate literary coverage only; not canonical text, reviewed gold, route behavior, retrieval truth, or graph truth.

No theology, canon, authorship, inspiration, history, chronology, fulfillment, identity, eschatological system, preferred translation, preferred reading, manuscript witness, or source tradition is decided.
Later canonical reuse never dictates Zechariah's seam; local form must independently support every boundary.
WEB chapters, paragraphs, poetry, blank lines, capitalization, footnotes, Strong's-style tags, and editorial cross-references are evidence only.
The Zech.14.5 and Zech.14.21 footnotes select no reading.
English lexical resemblance proves no Hebrew lexical identity or original-language boundary.
Haggai/Ezra dates and names are textual observations only, not reconstructed history or chronology.
Unresolved disagreement keeps the larger coherent unit at LOW confidence and routes an appeal.
Exact coverage validates mechanics, not literary correctness.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Distinct forms inside one chapter are wrongly merged at 5:4/5, 6:8/9, or 11:14/15.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Honor fresh seeing, word-arrival, and repeated sign-act commands.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Zech.13.1 is omitted or counted twice.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Expand spans and validate all 211 addresses exactly once.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Shepherd, Branch, king, or pierced-one identity/theology becomes boundary authority.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Use role terms only and keep full actions, laments, and outcomes.

major_premortem_failures.failure: Revelation imagery becomes one-to-one identity or timeline.
major_premortem_failures.mitigation: Label relations as reuse/resonance and freeze Zechariah seams locally.
